description: Reads a pasted data-licensing offer and returns what it finds, with the offer's own words quoted back: the figure set against the published span, the payment trigger, exclusivity, export method and data retention — each reported as stated or as not stated — plus the terms worth settling before signing and the question to ask on each. A term the offer is silent on is reported as a finding, not filled in. Nothing is stored, and this is not legal advice.

headcount.description: Full-time employees, so the price is set against the programs this company clears. Omit if unknown.

offer.description: The offer text: a term sheet, an email, or the part to be read.

years.description: Years of records. Omit if unknown.

name: read_data_offer
title: Read a data-licensing offer
